title: TwinGridShield: Consequence-Aware Runtime Authorization for LLM Grid-Agent Actions
abstract: arXiv:2608.15391v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM)-assisted energy-management tools can translate natural-language context into structured grid commands, but syntactic validity does not imply physical admissibility. This paper presents TwinGridShield, a model-independent runtime authorization layer that evaluates each proposed action in a deterministic network twin before release. The prototype checks connectivity, branch-flow, generator, and load-shedding invariants and records each decision in a hash-chained log. A controlled IEEE 14-bus study evaluates single-step switching, redispatch, and load-shedding actions using DC power flow and experimentally assigned branch ratings. In the matched-model experiment, a stochastic proposal source configured to select an unsafe action with probability p=0.84 produced 421 unsafe proposals in 500 attacked-condition trials, a realized rate of 84.2%. This value characterizes the configured surrogate and is not an empirical

translated_title: TwinGridShield：面向LLM电网代理操作后果感知的运行时授权机制
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）辅助的能源管理工具可以将自然语言上下文转换为结构化的电网命令，但语法有效性并不等同于物理可行性。本文提出TwinGridShield，一种模型无关的运行时授权层，在发布前在确定性网络孪生中评估每个提议操作。该原型检查连通性、支路潮流、发电机和减载不变量，并将每个决策记录在哈希链日志中。一项受控的IEEE 14节点研究评估了使用直流潮流和实验分配支路额定值的单步切换、重新调度和减载操作。在匹配模型实验中，一个随机提议源配置为以概率p=0.84选择不安全操作，在500次攻击条件下产生了421个不安全提议，实际发生率为84.2%。该值表征了配置的替代模型，并非经验性结果。
tldr: 本文提出TwinGridShield，一个通过确定性网络孪生和哈希链日志实现后果感知的运行时授权层，以在发布前过滤LLM生成的不可行电网操作。
en_tdlr: This paper presents TwinGridShield, a consequence-aware runtime authorization layer that uses a deterministic network twin and hash-chained logging to filter infeasible LLM-generated grid actions before release.
